core: Mitochondrial apoptosis downstream of cytochrome c release
name: Apoptosome-mediated caspase activation after mitochondrial factor release
rationale: All members cover the post-release step of intrinsic apoptosis (apoptotic factor release, apoptosome regulation and caspase cleavage), whereas the confusables cover upstream BCL-2 family, BH3-only and MOMP control.

qualifier: stem cell maintenance and bone marrow
name: Hematopoietic stem cell maintenance and bone marrow hemopoiesis
rationale: Members concern HSC proliferation, division, homeostasis and differentiation control plus bone marrow development and output, whereas confusables centre on myeloid/granulocyte lineage commitment, CSF signaling and RUNX1 transcription.

name: Coronavirus replicase polyprotein translation and host translation modulation
rationale: All members concern SARS-CoV replicase translation, maturation and replication-complex assembly or viral takeover of host translation, unlike confusables on genome replication, structural protein maturation or interferon responses.

name: Efferocytosis with phosphatidylserine exposure and phospholipid scrambling
rationale: Members cover dying-cell surface changes (PS exposure, ANO6 scrambling, blebbing, shrinkage) and their recognition and engulfment, whereas confusables emphasise scavenger receptors, aminophospholipid flippases or foam cell lipid uptake.

qualifier: coagulation factor cascade, fibrinolysis and von Willebrand factor adhesion
name: Coagulation cascade, fibrinolysis and von Willebrand factor-platelet adhesion
rationale: Members span the coagulation factor cascade and its inherited defects, fibrin formation and dissolution, and VWF/GPIb/GPVI-mediated platelet adhesion, whereas confusables are dominated by platelet GPCR (ADP, thrombin, thromboxane) and integrin-cytoskeleton signaling.

qualifier: histone and DNA methylation/acetylation and BAF/CHD remodeling
name: Histone and DNA modification and chromatin remodeling complexes
rationale: Most members concern histone methylation/acetylation/deacetylation, DNA methylation, imprinting and X inactivation, and BAF/CHD/NuRD remodelers, unlike confusables centred on SUMOylation, retroelement silencing, nucleosome assembly or TFAP2.

name: ABCA1-apolipoprotein A-I-mediated nascent HDL particle assembly
rationale: All members concern ABCA1/apoA-I-driven HDL formation and cholesterol sensing, whereas confusables cover HDL/LDL remodeling, LXR-regulated efflux and foam cell cholesterol storage.

qualifier: receptor activation and TCF target regulation
name: Canonical Wnt receptor activation and TCF/beta-catenin target regulation
rationale: Members span FZD/LRP5/RNF43/DVL receptor-level events, destruction complex disassembly and TCF-dependent transcription, whereas C1 holds beta-catenin phosphorylation and destruction complex mutants, C2 DVL degradation and C3/C4 Notch signaling.

name: Nephron, ureteric bud and glomerular kidney development
rationale: Nearly all members concern renal organogenesis from intermediate mesoderm through nephric duct, ureteric bud, nephron tubules and glomerulus, whereas confusables are lung, prostate, mammary and other branching glands.

qualifier: polymerase switching, long-patch repair and error-prone translesion synthesis
name: DNA polymerase switching in replication, gap-filling repair and mutagenic bypass
rationale: Members share PCNA-coordinated polymerase handoff for primer synthesis, telomere C-strand fill-in, long-patch BER, NER gap filling, error-prone translesion synthesis and somatic hypermutation, whereas confusables add nucleotide excision incision steps and error-free POLH bypass.

name: TNF-family-NF-kB signaling in ectodermal placode development
rationale: Members link TNF-family ligand-receptor binding and NF-kB defects causing ectodermal dysplasia to hair placode and ectodermal differentiation, whereas confusables cover hair cycle, epidermis/nail or tooth development.

name: Vitamin D hydroxylation to calcitriol and its inactivation
rationale: All members concern vitamin D3 metabolism, calcitriol synthesis by CYP27B1 and its catabolism by CYP24A1, unlike confusables on phosphate transport, FGF23-Klotho, PTH response or vitamin K.

name: MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis, RNA polymerase I/III transcription and translation initiation
rationale: Members span rRNA/tRNA transcription by Pol I and III, rRNA processing, ribosome assembly, cap-dependent translation initiation and MYC targets, whereas confusables centre on Pol II/HIV transcription, mRNA splicing and RNA modification/decay.

name: HSF1-mediated heat shock response and protein acetylation
rationale: Members cover HSF1 activation, attenuation and heat acclimation plus protein acetylation and redox response, unlike confusables on mitochondrial UPR and refolding, stress granules or histone/tubulin acetylation.

qualifier: GPCR-driven (ADP, thrombin, thromboxane, prostacyclin) with degranulation
name: GPCR-driven platelet activation and degranulation
rationale: Members are platelet P2Y, PAR, TP and prostacyclin receptor signaling, degranulation, SNARE and cytoskeletal changes, whereas confusables emphasise VWF/GPIb/GPVI adhesion and coagulation, or G12/13-Rap1-integrin signaling.

qualifier: pancreatic beta cell and exocrine regulation
name: bHLH-PAS circadian transcription and pancreatic beta cell regulation
rationale: Members join CLOCK/BMAL1/NPAS2 and NPAS4 transcription and locomotor rhythm with beta cell development/proliferation and pancreatic and mammary secretion, whereas confusables emphasise sleep, gluconeogenesis, glucocorticoids or PGC-1alpha/ROR metabolism (coherence is loose).

qualifier: IRS-AKT2 signaling to GLUT4 glucose uptake
name: Insulin receptor-AKT2 signaling to GLUT4 glucose uptake
rationale: Members span insulin receptor/IRS/AKT2 signaling, its attenuation and recycling, GLUT4 translocation, glucose import, glycogen synthesis and adiponectin, whereas confusables concern insulin secretion, incretins, glucokinase or exocyst trafficking.

name: RAC and RHOG GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are RAC1-3 and RHOG GTPase cycles plus Gbeta-gamma-CDC42 small GTPase signaling, whereas confusables cover CDC42/RHOJ and RHOA-D cycles or downstream WAVE/Arp2/3 actin effectors.

qualifier: RUNX2-driven osteoblast and intramembranous ossification, joint morphogenesis
name: RUNX2-driven osteoblast development, intramembranous ossification and joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover RUNX2-regulated osteoblast development, direct ossification, trabecular and suture formation, and joint, cartilage and tendon morphogenesis, whereas confusables emphasise chondrocyte maturation and endochondral ossification or osteoblast proliferation control.

name: KIR and MHC class Ib regulation of NK cell cytotoxicity
rationale: Members concern NK activation and degranulation control, KIR-cluster signatures, MHC class Ib presentation and protection from NK killing, whereas confusables emphasise activating NK receptors, positive cytotoxicity and T cell signatures.

qualifier: expression signatures including thymocyte and IL-2/IL-7 networks
name: T cell activation and differentiation expression signatures
rationale: Members are T cell activation, costimulation and thymocyte/CD8/gamma-delta differentiation signatures and regulators, whereas confusables cover thymic selection, proximal TCR/CD28 signaling events or NK/T cell markers.
Members split into generic protein oligomerization terms and magnesium ion transport/response with no single shared biological theme.

name: Lactate-pyruvate monocarboxylate and organic ion transmembrane transport
rationale: Members concern proton-coupled MCT/basigin lactate and pyruvate transport plus organic cation/anion and dicarboxylate carriers, whereas confusables focus on succinate/tricarboxylate, malate-aspartate shuttle or carnitine transport.

core: Bile acid and dietary lipid handling
name: Bile acid metabolism, intestinal lipid absorption and chylomicron/VLDL assembly
rationale: Members span bile acid synthesis, transport and signaling, sterol and vitamin E transport, dietary lipid absorption and triglyceride-rich lipoprotein assembly, whereas confusables cover xenobiotic/bilirubin transport or lipoprotein remodeling, clearance and cholesterol efflux.

name: Lung branching morphogenesis, mesenchymal growth and trachea formation
rationale: All members concern early lung and trachea organogenesis (branching, bud elongation, mesenchymal proliferation, vasculature), whereas confusables add limb/salivary epithelial-mesenchymal signaling or later saccular and pneumocyte differentiation.
